gloss: all at once, at one time

definitions.gloss: all at once, at one time
definitions.explanation: Doing or happening simultaneously rather than separately.

definitions.gloss: in one go, at a stretch

notes:
{一度|いちど}に means all at once or in one go — doing everything together rather than separately or gradually.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {一度|いちど}に + verb: do all at once
- {一度|いちど}に⟦{済|す}ます→済ます：02064_sumasu⟧: to finish all at once
- {一度|いちど}に⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧: a lot at once

TYPICAL USAGE:
- {一度|いちど}に⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧: eat everything at once
- {一度|いちど}に⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧: memorize all at once
- {一度|いちど}に⟦{運|はこ}ぶ→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧: carry in one trip

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {一度|いちど}に: all at once (emphasizes simultaneity or single attempt)
- ⟦{一気|いっき}→一気：08891_ikki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: in one breath, at a stretch (emphasizes continuous momentum)
- ⟦まとめて→まとめる：noentry⟧: together, in bulk (emphasizes grouping)

USAGE:
Do not confuse with ⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧ (once, one time) without に.
